definitions.explanation: The owner of a rental property — apartment, house, or building — who rents it out to tenants. The さん suffix adds a respectful, familiar tone.

examples.japanese: {大家|おおや}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
{大家|おおや}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked the landlord to make repairs.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大家|おおや}さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧で、{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Our landlord is very kind and even helped us when we moved in.

notes:
The word ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧ means landlord/property owner, and さん is the standard respectful suffix. In everyday conversation, {大家|おおや}さん is far more common than the plain form ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大家|おおや}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact the landlord
- {大家|おおや}さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: the landlord's permission
- {大家|おおや}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult with the landlord
- {大家|おおや}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧: the landlord lives (on the premises)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家主|やぬし}→家主：04079_yanushi⟧: landlord, property owner — more formal, used in legal and real estate contexts
- {貸主|かしぬし}: lessor — legal/contractual term
- ⟦{管理人|かんりにん}→管理人：03047_kanrinin⟧: building manager, superintendent — manages the property but may not own it

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with {大家|たいか} (master, authority in a field), which uses the same kanji but a different reading. {大家|おおや}さん always refers to a landlord.
